scenarioGeneral: For more natural wording, choose your situation and tell us who you are speaking to.
scenarioConversation: Everyday messages, idioms and natural replies. Add your relationship to the listener if it matters.
scenarioRestaurant: Ordering food, table requests, allergies and dietary needs. Include your restrictions explicitly.
scenarioShopping: Prices, sizes, payment and returns. Amounts and currencies stay as written.
scenarioHealth: Describe symptoms, duration and medicines. Translates your words without adding a diagnosis.
scenarioTravel: Hotels, directions and transport. Include the destination, date or booking details when relevant.
scenarioWork: Messages to colleagues or clients. Include the relationship and whether a plan is confirmed.
scenarioStudy: Lessons and technical material. Include the subject to help select the right terms.
